mapper.select: SELECT UC.ISSUE_NO, UC.COUPON_NO, C.COUPON_NAME, C.DISCOUNT_TYPE, C.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, C.MAX_DISCOUNT_PRICE, C.MIN_ORDER_PRICE, TO_CHAR(UC.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM USER_COUPON UC JOIN COUPON C ON UC.COUPON_NO = C.COUPON_NO WHERE UC.USER_ID = #{userId} AND UC.STATUS = 'UNUSED' AND UC.END_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY C.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_COUPON SET STATUS = 'USED', USED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE ISSUE_NO = #{issueNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_COUPON ( ISSUE_NO, USER_ID, COUPON_NO, STATUS, CDATETIME, END_DATE ) SELECT USER_COUPON_SEQ.NEXTVAL, U.USER_ID, C.COUPON_NO, 'UNUSED', SYSDATE, SYSDATE + C.EXPIRE_DAYS -- 쿠폰에 설정된 유효일수만큼 계산 FROM USERS U CROSS JOIN COUPON C WHERE C.COUPON_NO = #{couponNo} AND U.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' -- 활성 유저에게만 발급 AND NOT EXISTS ( -- 중복 발급 방지 (선택 사항) SELECT 1 FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND COUPON_NO = C.COUPON_NO AND STATUS = 'UNUSED' )
